# Aussie AI

> Melbourne-based AI automation agency for Australian small businesses. We build AI voice agents, AI receptionists, chat agents, inbox agents and workflow automations that answer enquiries, capture leads and book jobs using the tools businesses already use. Free audit, most first automations live within 1-2 weeks.

## Services

- [AI Receptionist](https://aussieai.shop/services/ai-receptionist): 24/7 AI phone and website receptionist for calls, bookings, enquiries and customer triage.
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://aussieai.shop/services/missed-call-text-back): automatic SMS follow-up when calls are missed so leads are never lost.
- [Workflow Automation](https://aussieai.shop/services/workflow-automation): connects forms, emails, spreadsheets, calendars, CRMs and alerts so updates happen automatically.
